name: lulu basics
goal: Full redesign of FreshCart from the Lulu app's basics: home (6-7 scrolls), product page, cart, checkout up to payment, Minutes, Hypermart, Lulu Money, categories, account, buy again, deals (4 scrolls each), with working search.
decisions: App name: Demo Cart (package com.democart.app), chosen by the user.
User asked for the exact Lulu design including font sizes: match layout, sizes, spacing, text sizes, weights and the source colour palette.
Not copied: Lulu's font files, logo, brand name, banner artwork, product photos and campaign wording. Closest open font: IBM Plex Sans (OFL), sizes solved from measured ink widths.
Images: DummyJSON demo product photos plus Open Food Facts / Wikimedia Commons photos (credits in IMAGE_CREDITS.md).
Checkout stops at the payment section; card fields are non-editable; demo orders only with Cash on Delivery.
Review dismissed: R1 Touch targets smaller than 48 x 48 dp; R2 Touch targets smaller than 48 x 48 dp; R11 Section titles not marked as headings

Review declined: R3 Text smaller than 11 sp; R4 Text smaller than 11 sp; R5 Text below WCAG AA contrast; R6 Text smaller than 11 sp; R7 Text below WCAG AA contrast; R8 Text below WCAG AA contrast; R9 Text below WCAG AA contrast; R10 Text smaller than 11 sp; R12 Near-miss left alignment; R13 Touch targets smaller than 48 x 48 dp; R14 Touch targets smaller than 48 x 48 dp; R15 Touch targets closer than 8 dp; R16 Too many text colours
notes: Lulu restores the last store on launch; its View cart pill swallows drags at 78% height, so flows drag from 600 dp.
uimatch flow tap: a regex anchored with ^ can't match an element whose text is empty (haystack starts with a space).
Portal ping can take more than 5 s on this phone; tools/flow.py waits longer.
